outcome: Rate of inflammation in incidental appendectomies
cohort: 20 pregnant women who underwent appendectomy beyond 24 weeks of pregnancy between January 2013 and January 2023 at a tertiary perinatal center
finding: Open appendectomy during pregnancy appears safe, with all cases in this study being performed via lower midline laparotomy.
mod_finding: The study found a high rate (95%) of cesarean delivery in women who underwent appendectomy during pregnancy.
